requirements.text: Administrator actions (create, edit, delete promotions) must complete within 1 second after submission.
requirements.rationale: Administrators require responsive management to maintain accurate content efficiently.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want to authenticate with a secure login mechanism so that only authorized personnel can manage promotions and user accounts.
requirements.rationale: The transcript mentions an administrator role managing promotions and user accounts, which implies a need for authentication to prevent unauthorized access.

requirements.text: The system shall maintain an audit log of all administrator actions on promotions and user accounts, recording who performed the action and when, so that changes are traceable for compliance and security reviews.
requirements.rationale: Managing user accounts and promotions by an administrator implies a need for accountability and auditability to satisfy security and regulatory standards.

requirements.text: As a visitor, I want to view promotions without being required to log in so that the website remains open and accessible to the public.
requirements.rationale: User Story 1 explicitly states 'As a visitor, I want to view available promotions', which implies no authentication barrier for browsing.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want to be able to deactivate or delete user accounts so that I can revoke access for former members or security threats.
requirements.rationale: User Story 3 states 'manage user accounts and access', which inherently includes the ability to remove accounts to control access.
